Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Choose one ordinary fire within reach. Read the fire's impressions of the previous day and make a Knowledge roll. Your touch is safe for this reading. On a Standard result, also see the appearance of its most recent visitor.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
Ten minutes.
Target / range / shape
One ordinary fire within reach.
Limits
One reading per fire per day.
Type
Magic / Utility

Read the fire's impressions of the previous day and make a Knowledge roll. Your touch is safe for this reading.

Weak
Learn when it was last lit and how many people warmed themselves beside it.
Standard
Also see the appearance of its most recent visitor.
Strong
Also hear one brief exchange spoken beside it that bears on a question you name, if such an exchange occurred.
